scope: Preparation requirements; no hardware launch authorization
required_guest_capture: Every raw IRIS_REGION JSON line including unique trial ID and parent_case_id
Raw mcycle boundaries, minstret delta, independent checksum and pass flag
Every suite/trial phase marker, final completion, fatal/trap and partial failure output
All five raw samples plus variance grouped by parent_case_id and hart
required_manager_capture: Raw manager stdout/stderr, UART and simulation logs on success and failure
Exact ELF, generated tables, runtime/CRT, compiler/libgcc and source inputs with hashes
Exact image/driver/platform/HWDB/runtime/plusargs hashes and source/loaded-image association unknowns
Separate kill, transfer, programming/setup, workload and cleanup host durations where observable
Current allocation/host boot/all-user process FD+maps inspection and shared lock receipts

instrumentation_before_launch.image_trace_support: Must inspect exact selected image; currently unverified here
instrumentation_before_launch.trace_windows_filters_and_volume: Coordinator must record supported settings or explicit unavailability
instrumentation_before_launch.image_autocounter_support: Must inspect exact selected image; no counter inferred from unrelated source
instrumentation_before_launch.extra_hpm_events: No fabricated events or perf counters; selected source CSR policy remains separate

smoke: Separate existing 12-region smoke first, without modifying its frozen inputs
hardware_lifecycle: Coordinator only: current exclusive allocation and complete visibility, hold host lock, kill -> infrasetup -> runworkload -> kill with owned failure cleanup
cache_policy: Stage/cache only exact hash-verified artifacts; never bypass reset/programming/setup
archive_policy: Archive quiescent job including failures outside job directory using user-owned firesim/capture_run.py
heldout_policy: Genuine heldouts remain separate and are never used to fit
